{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids and keep the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only use the latest (most complete) data for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now, check the distribution of severity
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Extract the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = severity_counts.get('severe', 0)

fraction_severe"}
